messages.text:
Once it’s delivered, you can request a refund for the cookware set, but the shop must receive it back first. The records currently show it hasn’t been delivered or received back, so I can’t propose a refund now. (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders) (refund-policy/v2/return)

The request must be made within 30 days of the recorded delivery time. (refund-policy/v2/window)
